jobs.title: AI Application Engineer – AI Products (LLM & RAG) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Machine Learning Reply, we help organizations turn cutting-edge AI technologies into real-world applications and scalable digital products.

 To strengthen our team, we are looking for an AI Application Engineer who enjoys building AI-powered solutions and intelligent product features using modern machine learning and generative AI technologies.

 While our GenAI Engineers focus on model development and AI architectures, AI Application Engineers focus on building user-facing AI applications and turning AI capabilities into scalable products.

 In this role, you will work at the intersection of AI engineering, backend development, product development and cloud deployment, building production-ready AI systems that create real business value.

 Tasks 
 As an AI Application Engineer, you design and build AI-powered applications and product features for enterprise clients.
 Your projects may include:
 Designing and developing AI applications, such as enterprise assistants, AI copilots, semantic search platforms and intelligent automation systems

 Building LLM-powered applications using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and modern AI frameworks

 Developing end-to-end AI products, integrating LLM APIs, enterprise data sources and backend services

 Designing scalable AI microservices and APIs to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms

 Implementing vector search, embeddings pipelines and knowledge retrieval systems

 Rapidly prototyping AI product features and proof-of-concepts and evolving them into production systems

 Collaborating closely with product managers, designers, AI engineers and enterprise customers to develop impactful AI solutions

 Deploying AI systems to cloud platforms and production environments using modern DevOps practices

 Ensuring reliable, scalable and observable AI services through CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and containerized deployments

 Benefits 
 Work in an open and collaborative environment within the global Reply network and build next-generation AI applications and intelligent digital products

 Collaboration with interdisciplinary teams including AI engineers, software developers and data scientists across industries such as Banking, Insurance, Automotive and Retail

 A very active social program including paid training, conferences, communities of practice, hackathons and Reply XChange

 Monetary Benefits include: Mobility package, Gym subsidy & WellPass, Insurance & Pension Scheme, Corporate Savings Plan, KiTa and Childcare Allowance

 Flexible work arrangement between home office, EU-wide workation options, on site office-work in our downtown Munich office with access to Stammstrecke, and client on site visits

 Requirements 
 Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a comparable technical field

 Convincing communication and presentation skills in German and English in order to participate in workshops of both languages

 Strong programming skills in Python and modern backend frameworks

 Experience building applications using AI, machine learning or generative AI technologies

 Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector databases

 Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP

 Engaging directly with enterprise clients to understand their business challenges and identify high-impact opportunities for AI-driven solutions

 Nice to have 
 Experience running technical workshops or facilitating solution design sessions

 Experience developing APIs, microservices and scalable backend systems, including vector databases

 Experience with containerization and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes or similar)

 Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex or HuggingFace

 Experience deploying AI services in cloud environments

 Knowledge of AI observability, monitoring, and evaluation of LLM systems

 Example projects you may work on 
 Enterprise AI knowledge assistants

 AI copilots for inter

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer - Agent Evaluation Platform (x/f/m)
jobs.description:
Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare!
   Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.
   What you'll do 
   We are looking for a Staff AI Software Engineer to join the AI Evaluation team (EvalX) at Doctolib and help every AI product team measure, understand and improve the quality, reliability and safety of their systems.
   Our AI products span patient-facing conversational agents, AI-powered phone assistants and clinical assistants supporting healthcare professionals. EvalX builds the platform, tools and methods that let these teams evaluate continuously, and our ambition is to make evaluation a core engineering practice.
   In this role, you will work at the intersection of platform engineering, applied AI and product teams: you build shared evaluation capabilities, and you work directly with the teams that use them so they actually get adopted.
   In this role, you will:
 Design, ship, and operate production-grade evaluation tooling (APIs, services, CI/CD integrations) used by AI product teams across Doctolib

 Work hands-on with product teams to assess how they evaluate today, define improvement plans, and help them own their evaluation quality

 Design evaluation strategies for agentic systems, combining deterministic checks, LLM-as-a-judge, simulation-based testing, and human review

 Build intelligent capabilities for production sampling, dataset representativeness monitoring, distribution-shift detection, and test case generation

 Help teams define meaningful quality metrics, representative datasets, and reliable quality gates throughout the development lifecycle

 Turn recurring product needs into reusable, self-service platform capabilities, and measure success through adoption, team autonomy, and evaluation coverage

 Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that shape Doctolib's AI platform and best practices for building and evaluating agentic systems

   Who you are 
   Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply! You could be our next team mate if you:
 Have 6+ years of experience as a software engineer, with significant experience using Python; or as a machine learning engineer

 Have built or operated evaluation for LLM-powered or agentic systems: datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, human review, production-driven evaluation

 Understand and promote software development best practices

 Are product-oriented and enjoy working directly with other teams, challenging assumptions, and turning complex needs into concrete solutions

 Can influence engineering practices and drive change without hierarchical authority: your job is not done until your solution is adopted

 Are comfortable speaking and writing in English in your day-to-day with the team

   Now, it would be fantastic if you: 
 Have experience with applied ML techniques such as embeddings, clustering, statistical sampling, and distribution monitoring

 Have experience building developer platforms or internal tooling, or in a Forward Deployed Engineering role

 Have experience in the medical domain or another regulated environment

   What we offer 
 Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

 Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care 

 Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

 Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

 A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

 Enrol

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Your profile Machine Learning Engineer Turba Labs   · Heidelberg (Germany) or San Francisco Bay Area (USA) · On-site, hybrid or remote · Full-time · Candidates must live in Germany or the USA 
 A scheduling idea that works in a notebook is a rumor until it survives a client's cluster. Data centers now run mixed clusters of GPU generations, vendors and accelerators, and the software that schedules work on them was mostly built for uniform hardware. Turba Labs is building what replaces it, and it has to work on infrastructure we do not control. 
 Two products. The   Scheduler   runs live on our clients' infrastructure and decides which workload runs on which GPU, and when. The   Simulator   answers a related question before a data center spends a cent: given a planned build-out, what is the best way to use it? You make what we build reliable enough for a data center to depend on. 
 What you will own 
 Research to production. Take a validated idea into the Scheduler: design it, build it, test it, roll it out, monitor it, and own what happens after.
 The ML platform's architecture. The decisions others build on, including when a learned approach earns its operational cost over a simple heuristic.
 Training, evaluation and benchmarking pipelines. Every scheduling policy and performance model reproducible and comparable, so progress is measured, not argued.
 GPU-level reality. Profile and optimize workloads and models on heterogeneous hardware, and feed what you measure back into the Simulator.
 Safe failure. Guardrails, fallbacks and observability, so the system running on infrastructure we do not control degrades gracefully, never dramatically.
 The interfaces. Clear contracts and release plans with the infrastructure and product engineers around you.
 Who you are 
 You have shipped ML into production and carry the operational weight, not just the model.
 You are strong in Python and PyTorch and practice real software engineering: tests, review, CI, and design that survives the next person.
 You think in trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost and risk, and you can say why you chose what you chose.
 You are comfortable close to the hardware, or hungry to be.
 You write designs and tickets that others can execute without a follow-up call.
 We do not screen on years or titles. We screen on the hardest system you have shipped and how deeply you understood it. 
 A plus 
 GPU performance work: profiling, CUDA, inference engines such as vLLM or TensorRT, distributed training.
 Experience with cluster or workload schedulers, Linux systems work and Docker.
 Reinforcement learning, optimization or simulation in a production setting.
 Deploying software into customer-managed or on-premises environments.
 Why this 
 This is infrastructure software that changes how AI compute gets used. What you ship here runs on real hardware in real data centers, with real money on the line, alongside the researchers who design the methods. 

 Why us?

jobs.title: Computer Vision and Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Computer Vision and Machine Learning (CV/ML) Engineer to develop and deploy intelligent perception systems for our autonomous drone-in-a-box platform. You will work on challenging real-world computer vision problems, from real-time object detection and tracking on embedded devices to advanced scene understanding and cloud-based inference. As part of a small, technical team, you will own solutions across our software stack, taking algorithms and models from prototype to deployment. This position is for an on-site employee for our Zurich office.
 Responsibilities
 Design and develop a wide variety of computer vision and machine learning features for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) applications
 Train, fine-tune and evaluate deep learning models for tasks such as object detection, instance segmentation, image retrieval/reidentification
 Optimize algorithms and models for edge devices (NVIDIA Jetson and Qualcomm Dragonwing), and integrate them into our image and video processing pipelines
 Monitor ML model performance in real-world deployments and set up workflows for continuous improvement (data collection, curation, labeling, retraining, evaluation)
 Evaluate and integrate large/vision language models for scene understanding, situational awareness, and hazard analysis, including prompt design, performance benchmarking, and production deployment
 Qualifications
 Degree in Computer Science, Robotics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
 Solid understanding of computer vision and machine learning fundamentals
 Strong programming skills in Python and C++, with experience developing production-grade software that powers CV/ML systems
 Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow, ONNX, TensorRT, CUDA
 Experience with end-to-end model development: from dataset curation, labeling strategies, active learning workflows to deployment and optimization for edge devices
 Excellent oral and written skills in English
 Work permit in Switzerland required
 Bonus Points
 Good understanding of 3D vision and robotics perception, along with hands-on experience with OpenCV and ROS/ROS2, is a strong plus
 Experience with NVIDIA Jetson and Qualcomm edge devices, and their CV/ML SDKs
 Experience with transformers, large/vision language models and prompt design for perception tasks
 Experience with complex GStreamer pipelines and custom plugin development
 100% · On-site
